lesson.plain_english: when a small tool or clone changes what builders can ship, copy, automate, or replace
lesson.big_question: When does a viral dev tool stop being a toy and start becoming leverage?
lesson.simple_analogy: one clever repo turning into a forklift for every developer who was previously carrying boxes by hand
lesson.common_misunderstanding: People focus on the launch. The useful question is who gains control, who inherits risk, and what changes tomorrow.
lesson.hard_receipt: AI.cc reports 300% growth in API integrations
lesson.listener_payoff: By the end, listeners should understand developer leverage well enough to explain why today's AI story matters tomorrow.
lesson.operator_lesson: Do not ask only what launched. Ask what new permission, risk, cost, or accountability chain just appeared.
lesson.episode_spine: AI.cc Reports 300% Growth in API Integrations as Developers Abandon Single-Provider Strategies in Q1 2026 is a developer-leverage story: who can build, copy, and ship faster than the market can price in.
